note: Four thematic environmental review zones, NOT equal-area geographic quadrants or road/race boundaries.

zones.name: Western Gateway
zones.theme: Bridge engineering, civic landscapes, paved arrival surfaces

stops.focus: Arch silhouettes, concrete weathering, rusted railings, protected bank clearance
Masonry, carved statuary, reflective water and close-up pavement detail

zones.name: Central Forest & Wetlands
zones.theme: Flatwoods canopy, shaded canals, wetland biodiversity

stops.focus: A genuine water view alongside the Flatwoods, canopy LODs and dry footpath
Natural lagoon shore, reeds, driftwood, mud, rock and footbridge clearance
Lighthouse masonry, natural shoreline transitions and uninterrupted waterfront view

stops.destinationName: U.S. Coast Guard Station Belle Isle
stops.focus: Open-water horizon, protected built edge and shoreline rock placement

zones.name: Recreation & Waterfront
zones.theme: Beach grading, boating structures, recreational paths

stops.focus: Dry/wet-sand transition, shoreline collision and unobstructed recreation area
Marina piers, textured masonry, vehicle-path clearance and water detail
